verdict.rationale: Notte docs confirm sessions expose a standard CDP endpoint that Playwright can connect to (notte-docs-11), which directly supports bringing existing Playwright/CDP code to Notte's cloud browsers. However, there's no explicit mention of Puppeteer compatibility, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this integration working smoothly beyond the docs. Missing for 10: Puppeteer-specific support evidence, community/hands-on validation of CDP interop, and details on session/auth persistence when using external automation frameworks.
